'''Kobe Michael Sanders''' is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Cal Poly Mustangs men's basketball|Cal Poly Mustangs]] and [[Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball|Nevada Wolf Pack]].

==Early life and high school==
Sanders attended [[Christian High School (San Diego)|Christian High School]] located in [[San Diego, California]]. During his [[Senior (education)|senior]] season, he averaged 16.7 points and 5.0 rebounds per game. Ultimately, Sanders committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Cal Poly Mustangs men's basketball|Cal Poly Mustangs]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ho |first=Matthew |date=January 20, 2023 |title=Sanders' unique skills on and off floor can help Cal Poly |work=The Tribune (San Luis Obispo, CA) |pages=3B}}</ref>

==College career==
=== Cal Poly ===
During his four-year career with the [[Cal Poly Mustangs|Mustangs]] of [[San Luis Obispo, California|San Luis Obispo]] from 2020 through 2024, Sanders appeared in 100 games with 71 starts, where he averaged 10.1 points, 2.8 rebounds, and 2.2 assists per game, with a career-high of 35 points, while also earning All-[[Big West Conference|Big West]] Honorable Mention honors after averaging 19.6 points per game in his final season with the team.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Murray |first1=Chris |title=Nevada basketball lands commitment from Cal Poly guard transfer Kobe Sanders |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/news/reporters/nevada-basketball-lands-commitment-from-cal-poly-guard-transfer-kobe-sanders |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref><ref name="Jim Krajewski transfer">{{cite web |last1=Krajewski |first1=Jim |title=Nevada men's basketball team adds Kobe Sanders from transfer portal |url=https://www.rgj.com/story/sports/college/2024/04/11/nevada-mens-basketball-team-adds-kobe-sanders-from-transfer-portal/73281899007/ |access-date=8 June 2025 |website=Reno Gazette Journal}}</ref> In December 2023, Sanders set an all-time school record for most [[Free throw|free throws]] made in a game without a miss, making all 17 of his free-throw attempts against [[2023–24 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team|CSUN]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hildebrand |first=Jack |date=December 29, 2023 |title=Kobe Sanders scores 33 but Cal Poly Men's Basketball falls short to CSUN |work=Mustang News}}</ref> As a senior, Sanders set [[California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo|Cal Poly]]'s [[NCAA Division I|Division I]]-era single-season record for free throws made, with 174.<ref>Sports Reference College Basketball: Cal Poly Mustangs MBB Leaders & Records</ref> After the conclusion of the 2023-24 season, he decided to enter his name into the NCAA transfer portal.<ref name="Jim Krajewski transfer"/>

=== Nevada ===
Sanders transferred to play for the [[Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball|Nevada Wolf Pack]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Stefanson |first1=Mike |title=Nevada basketball's Kobe Sanders talks joining the Wolf Pack, upbringing, hobbies and more |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/news/reporters/kobe-sanders-one-on-one |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref> On November 22, 2024, he scored 10 points including the game-winning three in a 64-61 victory over [[2024–25 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Murray |first1=Chris |title=Nevada's Kobe Sanders hits game-winning 3-pointer in final seconds to down VCU |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/news/reporters/nevadas-kobe-sanders-hits-game-winning-3-pointer-in-final-seconds-to-down-vcu |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref> On February 22, 2025, Sanders scored 30 points; however, the Wolf Pack would fall to [[2024–25 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Boise State]] 70-69.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Raridon |first1=Derek |title=Nevada loses last second thriller 70-69 to Boise State despite Sanders' 30-point night |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/news/reporters/nevada-loses-last-second-thriller-70-69-to-boise-state-despite-sanders-30-point-night |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref> On February 25, 2025, he tallied 27 points in a win over [[2024–25 Wyoming Cowboys basketball team|Wyoming]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Raridon |first1=Derek |title=Kobe Sanders' 27-point night helps Nevada basketball blow out Wyoming, 84-61 |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/newsletter-daily/sanders-27-point-night-helps-nevada-blow-out-wyoming-84-61 |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref> Sanders finished the 2024-25 season averaging 15.8 points, 4.5 assists, 3.9 rebounds and 1.1 steals per game. He was named third-team All-[[Mountain West Conference|Mountain West]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Murray |first1=Chris |title=Here's how Nevada basketball product Kobe Sanders fared at the Portsmouth Invitational |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/news/reporters/heres-how-nevada-basketball-product-kobe-sanders-fared-at-the-portsmouth-invitational |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=8 June 2025}}</ref> After the conclusion of the 2024-25 season, he declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]] while also accepting an invite to participate in the 2025 [[NBA draft combine|NBA scouting combine]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Murray |first1=Chris |title=Here's how Nevada basketball alum Kobe Sanders did at the NBA draft combine |url=https://nevadasportsnet.com/sports/mens-basketball/heres-how-nevada-basketball-alum-kobe-sanders-did-at-the-nba-draft-combine |website=Nevada Sports Net |access-date=7 June 2025}}</ref>
